issue: Manifest/Handoff schemas inconsistent and missing atomic goal metadata

issue: CompiledArtifact core fields and all artifact definitions were incomplete
fix: Added exact P01 domain contract aligned to design compendium.

issue: ArtifactCandidate was modeled as a competing authority instead of CompiledArtifact(status=candidate)

fix: Aligned ArtifactValidationRun/Result/Failure/Counterexample and canonical artifact_validation_run table.

issue: Approval/activation/revalidation event aliases and record fields differed from P02 persistence
fix: Aligned record fields and event names; activation remains P02 Active Pointer transaction.

issue: RuntimeCandidateDecision conflicted with canonical RuntimeExecutionDecision

issue: PlanTemplateRuntime/MaterializedPlanCandidate aliases did not match canonical TemplateRuntime/UserGoalPlanCandidate port

issue: DecisionRuleRuntime/RuleEvaluationContext/RuleDecision aliases conflicted with RuleRuntime contract
fix: Aligned RuleRuntime, RuleDecisionContext and RuleDecisionResult.

issue: Gateway route enum differed from FastGatewayPath and core port did not expose canonical RuntimeRequestContext → RuntimeExecutionDecision

issue: CaseRuntime method signatures and ModelRoute core fields differed from design contract
fix: Aligned retrieve/adapt ports and canonical route/budget/fallback fields.

issue: Management API paths lacked a frozen canonical core and A2A exposure boundary was distributed
fix: Froze /api/v1 core routes, exposure allowlist, RBAC, A2A/SSE contracts.

issue: Event, queue and feature flag names were not centrally locked
fix: Added canonical registry and per-package contract lock.

issue: Runtime packages proposed duplicate detail tables that could compete with artifact_execution/artifact_feedback
fix: Core execution/feedback authority fixed to canonical tables; type-specific data is decision_snapshot/impact or non-authoritative child projection.

issue: P00 still allowed READY_FOUNDATION_ONLY although user requires first execution only after v1.2.3 final

issue: Package depth and self-check coverage were weaker than later packages
fix: Added execution checklist, contract locks, standardized evidence and self-check.

issue: No machine-checkable cross-package field alignment existed
fix: Added registry schema hashes, package locks and validate-all script.

issue: Final audit did not have machine-readable consumption of package contract hashes
fix: P13 now consumes registry and all package locks.

issue: P14 could be mistaken for a fifteenth formal package
fix: P14 excluded; master manifest states formal set is P00-P13.
